minutes.headline: Planning Board continued the Bright Farms site plan hearing to Nov 9 pending stormwater fixes; approved the ANR.
minutes.summary: The board heard an informal common-driveway inquiry for 233 Lancaster Avenue, then spent most of the meeting on the Bright Farms greenhouse site plan, where the peer reviewer's stormwater comments remain open. It approved the ANR for 361 Mass Ave, adopted subdivision rule changes, filled two committee seats, and discussed the stormwater bylaw for the special town meeting without deciding.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board continued the Bright Farms greenhouse site plan hearing to November 9 at 6:30 while stormwater plan revisions are completed.
The board approved the ANR plan for 361 Massachusetts Avenue as submitted, 4-0.
The board adopted changes to the subdivision rules and regulations, 4-0, after a public hearing with no public input.
The board filled seats on the TCP building design committee and the capital planning committee, both 4-0.
The stormwater bylaw decision for the special town meeting was deferred to Nov 9, and a 3-0 recommendation asked that 360 Flat Hill Road stay agricultural while options are explored.

why_it_matters: The Bright Farms greenhouse is not yet approved, so its stormwater design, water withdrawal and drainage easement are still open and can change before a decision.
The stormwater bylaw responds to a federal permit requirement, and residents will be asked to vote on it at the special town meeting.
The 360 Flat Hill Road recommendation goes to the select board and bears on whether that land stays in agricultural use.
watch_next: November 9 at 6:30: the Bright Farms hearing resumes with revised stormwater plans, and the board takes up the stormwater bylaw for the special town meeting.
November 17 special town meeting, with a draft Bright Farms decision to be ready for the November 23 meeting.
